research.name: scroll-craft
research.note: Agent skill with a small scroll engine for building pinned, video-scrubbed pages, plus a gate that stops each build repeating earlier ones.

effects: video scrubbed by scroll position (engine seeks currentTime per frame)
worldflight mode: one fixed stage with crossfaded video legs driven by a spacer
fingerprint gate requiring each build to differ from earlier ones on 4 of 6 dimensions
per-act --sc-p scroll progress property for bespoke interactions

unverified: The signature effects were confirmed in the engine source and README, not seen in motion: only still frames from the three README recordings (media/*.webp) were viewed, and the 50-second walkthrough video and the live example sites were not opened.
The engine and skill were not run in this session; the README says it has only ever been run on Windows.
